items.title: Chinese Stocks Turn Biggest Losers as Global AI Trade Stumbles
items.description: Chinese firms have emerged as the biggest losers of the faltering global AI trade, a setback for Beijing’s efforts to use stock markets to supercharge its ambition of technological supremacy.
